unit.why: A midrashic tale (Genesis Rabbah) of Rabbi Judah the Prince serving Antoninus cold Sabbath food that tasted better than hot weekday food, explained by the 'spice' of Shabbat.

stories.start_quote: רבינו הקדוש עשה סעודה לאנטינוניס ביום השבת
stories.summary_en: Rabbi Judah the Prince hosts Antoninus once on Shabbat with cold dishes and once on a weekday with hot ones; the emperor prefers the Sabbath food, and the rabbi explains that the missing spice is the Sabbath itself, which Antoninus does not keep.

tags.why: The story turns on the Sabbath and Sabbath food.
Rabbi hosts the Roman emperor Antoninus.

quotes: וכי אוצרות של המלך חסר כלום
tags.why: Antoninus is the ruler, and the exchange takes place with him.
The tale praises Rabbi Judah the Prince, a pre-Hasidic sage, and is taken from Midrash Rabbah.

quotes: זה התבלין שנחסר זה הוא השבת
tags.why: The punchline is a homiletic point about the Sabbath.

missing_concepts: Sabbath food / Sabbath meals (cholent, cold dishes)
talmudic-midrashic sages (Rabbi Judah ha-Nasi and Antoninus)
